theorem lg_target {a b : ℤ} : a.natAbs = b.natAbs ↔ a * a = b * b := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [NatAbs.eq_iff_pos_neg]
    exact Or.inl (by erw [h])
  · intro h
    have : a = b ∨ a = -b := by
      rw [NatAbs.eq_iff_pos_neg at h]
      rcases h with (h1 | h2)
      · exact Or.inl h1
      · exact Or.inr h2
    cases this with h1 h2
    · exact h1
    · exact (by rw [h2]; rfl)
